audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Mordekaiser wins levels 1, 2, 3, 4-5 and 2+ items, in a 56.65% FAV matchup whose own whys text describes Heimerdinger winning those stages.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is [Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Mordekaiser, Skill, Heimerdinger] and whys[0..3] already read as Heimerdinger-favoured ("Morde has no dash and no early burst", "his E-pull-into-Q-slam all-in suicidal"). Both layers contradicted the data and each other's prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,3,6 flipped to Heimerdinger, row 2 to Skill, ratings raised accordingly; Level 6 stays Mordekaiser (Realm of Death), first item stays Skill. Proposed as one atomic group across phases[N].side/.rating and win[N].

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Heimerdinger at 4-5 (full nest + grenade stun), Mordekaiser at 6 (Realm of Death), Liandry's/Rylai's first item, late scaling. Four spike entries present.
audit.corrected: Kept; added Realm of Death's real 140/120/100s cooldown so the 'survive it' advice has a number attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Stand in his E' but its body ('Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown') describes spending one of YOUR spells — it says nothing about Death's Grasp. No cooldown numbers anywhere on Morde's kit.
audit.why: Death's Grasp (E, 16/14/12/10/8s, 700 range) is his only way to move you, and Obliterate (Q, 8/7/6/5/4s, 675 range) explicitly deals increased damage when it hits a single enemy — so the pull is what turns a nest fight into his fight. Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1, the longest punishable cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the pull-into-lone-target-Obliterate chain; breakdown.cooldowns now carries 140/120/100s for R, 16s for E, and 11s flat for your grenade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was mentioned only in report[8]; the actionable lines (dosFull, wants.you) never told you to buy it or when.
audit.why: Indestructible (W) stores damage he deals and takes into a shield he can consume to heal — turret chip and rocket poke feed it, so extended trades flip without anti-heal. This is the flagged missing interaction for this matchup.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and dosFull[1].d now name Oblivion Orb / Mercury's Treads against Indestructible.

audit.why: Packet flagged wants.foe[2] 'Land Realm of Death' as a probable wrong ability name. It is Mordekaiser's actual R name in the kit file — a false positive.

edits.before: His R isolates you — build MR, turret-poke pre-6. Heimerdinger wins the Realm of Death cooldown windows.
edits.after: Realm of Death isolates you off your nest, but it's 140s at rank 1 — survive it once and you own the whole gap.

edits.before: Build MR and turret-poke early. Track Realm of Death before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build MR, nest up, count his 140s Realm of Death. Obliterate hits hardest on a lone target — stay in your turrets.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Death's Grasp drags you off the nest into a lone-target Obliterate.

edits.before: Keep Mordekaiser farming inside turret range, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he commits into the nest.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus an early Oblivion Orb — his Indestructible shield-heal is what wins him extended trades.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm — no turrets follow. Survive it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death: 140/120/100s — no turrets follow you in. Survive it and the next two minutes are yours. - Death's Grasp: 16s at rank 1 — his only way onto you. - Your grenade stun: 11s flat — hold it for his step-up.

edits.before: Poke his W shield down with Micro-Rockets, then commit your grenade-stun all-in only while his Realm of Death is on cooldown
edits.after: Rush Oblivion Orb — Indestructible heals off your chip; then commit the grenade-stun all-in only while Realm of Death is on cooldown

notes: Packet defect 'wrong ability name at wants.foe[2] — Land Realm of Death' is a FALSE POSITIVE: Realm of Death is Mordekaiser's real R. Level chart was inverted on 5 of 7 rows against a 56.65%/263-game FAV matchup; both layers proposed as one atomic group. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Mordekaiser's Realm of Death can be Cleansed/QSS'd, and whether Heimerdinger's turrets persist through the realm's duration — both left out of the text rather than guessed.
